title.en: Granting Year-End Bonus to National Government Officials and Employees Equivalent to Two-Week Basic Pay But Not Less Than P500 Nor More Than
title.orig: Granting Year-End Bonus to National Government Officials and Employees Equivalent to Two-Week Basic Pay But Not Less Than P500 Nor More Than

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00997_1984_html.txt

text.en:
All officials and employees of the National Government including the members of the Armed Forces
of the Philippines and the Integrated National Police are entitled to the year-end bonus equivalent to two-week
basic pay but not less than P500 nor more than P1,000.

Officials and employees already receiving year-end bonus or incentive pay or equivalent beyond their
basic pay and duly authorized monthly allowance shall no longer be entitled to this year-end bonus.

Funds needed to implement this Order shall be drawn from savings which shall be duly certified by the
agencies as to their availability. Any deficiency in agency savings may be covered from any available savings
of the national government.

The procedures, rules and regulations needed to carry out this Executive Order shall be formulated and
issued by the Office of Budget and Management.

The year-end bonus provided herein shall be effective immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of November in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Eighty-Four.
